scenarios.expected: Allowed recipients see the intended conversation and attachments; the activity records the action. Legal Only and Working Team content stay outside the Business User view; failed attachments do not falsely appear filed.
scenarios.actual: On C-147 Comments offered Legal Only and Contract Team with Contract Team checked; the description below the composer read "Visible to Legal and all Contract team members." and, for Legal Only, "Visible to Administrators and Legal Team Members." No Internal team option was offered. Posts showed under Nadia Haddad with Legal Only or Contract Team badges; M-132 offered Legal Only and Matter Team, Matter Team first. Typing @Dan opened People and Files tabs; choosing Daniel Okafor filled Mentioned, Remove Daniel Okafor emptied it, and the re-picked mention posted without a prompt. A plain typed name gave no Mentioned list. A Legal Only mention of Jonas Weber raised Widen the audience?; Cancel kept the draft and posted nothing; Widen and post posted at Contract Team. Attach files (Up to 5 files.) listed two PDFs, Remove dropped one, six chosen files listed five; the post carried the notice PDF, its filename opened a preview with Download and File to Contract, and Download returned fixture-identical bytes. With the post request aborted the composer showed "The comment could not be posted. Try again.", kept text and paper, showed no Filed to marker, a reload found no post, and the retry posted once. File to Contract (also in the preview) opened File attachment with New Document and New Version on an existing Document; filing as a New Document left the attachment on the thread with "Filed to ..., version 1" and the Document on the record. Her own menu offered Edit and Delete only; Cancel kept the text, Save showed edited with no audience control, Delete asked Delete this comment? and left Comment deleted by its author. On M-132 the Comments button read 56 unread (her own two posts excluded), the first load held 50 rows, Show older loaded the rest, and reading set unread to 0. History listed 25 entries and Show older 50. Blocked reads showed "The conversation could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again.", "The earlier comments could not be read. Try again." (loaded rows kept, retry loaded more) and "The history could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again."; reopening recovered. R-125 in the Inbox offered Legal only (checked) and Shared with requester with a Comments applet only; converted R-123 showed no applets and a Status link that opened C-147. A stand-in older working_team comment showed Internal team on C-147 and Working team on R-125.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The work lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Only records and accounts named DOC-029 conversations were created; no organisation settings changed. Debug runs before the recorded run left further DOC-029 conversations records; they are not credited.

Fixture Requests, conversions, team changes, the C-148 archive, 56 bulk Matter comments, and one stand-in working_team comment per thread were made through the API as the acting role; the article steps under test were followed in the browser.
Recovery checks used browser route interception to fail a comment post, a thread read, an earlier page, and a History read.

Not exercised: filing an attachment as a New Version, Portal History entries for business Field edits and for Fields that are now legal-only, and the unread badge's exclusion of removed comments in isolation.
The first attempts of two supplementary checks failed on reviewer-script errors and passed after correction; both attempts are kept in the walkthrough log with their dispositions.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, round 2 (DOC-029r2 compatibility reviewer (conversations)) found the article compatible: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, and its only comments change is the colour of an archived author's name, which the article does not describe. I replayed the round 1 V-C07 comment checks for all three roles on the work2 lab, and all 30 steps passed. From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. The article makes no statement about the setup wizard Authentication step or two-factor enrollment. The change touches only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test, so no statement in the article can become wrong.
